0022600163.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-5, fourth in the Central and 13th in the East, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (6-1, first in the Atlantic and first in the East, on a three-game winning streak), with Chicago 1-3 on the road and 0-2 at home while Philadelphia is 3-0 on the road and 3-1 at home. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Bulls won the 2025-26 series 2-1, but Philadelphia beat Chicago 157-137 in their last meeting, on March 25, 2026 in Philadelphia. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring) and Dailyn Swain (day-to-day, back soreness, game-time decision), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Joel Embiid (foot) and LeBron James (back) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions.
